headline: An OpenAI executive known as Tibo has promised users a product release or a usage reset every day for the next 28 days.
score_reason: Pool score kept: concerns heavy ChatGPT and Codex users, but it is a promise relayed through social posts and commentary.
importance_line: Heavy ChatGPT and Codex users could see daily improvements or usage resets, but the pledge rests on social-media posts and the outlet’s own view that user trust is strained.
summary: Synced, a Chinese AI news outlet, reports in a commentary republished by 36Kr that OpenAI executive Tibo has promised 28 consecutive days of releases or resets, understood as daily product improvements or a full reset of usage limits. The commentary says the pledge follows OpenAI's Developers Day, after which heavy users complained of tighter quotas and slower models, and that Tibo named simpler products and more usage per plan among OpenAI's four priorities.
notes: ABAB News (original pool link) unreadable; text read at 36Kr. ABAB News describes Tibo as OpenAI’s product head; 36Kr does not give a title. Url is the page where the text was read.
